_comment: The strict flag set every design session verified under, made explicit.
P0 finding: the shipped ci.yml ran bare `tsc --strict ...` with no target,
so it defaulted to ES5/lib.es5 and failed on Array.prototype.includes and
SharedArrayBuffer — the typecheck gate would have been red on a fresh
clone. target/lib are pinned here so every package inherits the same one.
